newsitem.title: UK: Medeva falls as results disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Medeva falls as results disappoint.

text.p: Shares in British drug group Medeva Plc fell 19p to 237-1/2p as results came in at the low end of analysts' expectations.
First-half, pre-tax profit of 46 million stg, although higher than last year's first half at 33.9 million, was at the bottom end of forecasts of 44.5 million to 52 million.
Analysts said that the stock may drift lower later as the statement which came with results was "measured".
"It was not a cautious but a measured statement, not particularly encouraging and the shares will probably hold or drift lower," said SocGen analyst Paul Diggle.
Analysts said disappointing sales of Medeva's Ionamin also affected the share price.
First half sales were seven million stg.
"We were expecting 26 million for the full year and now we're expecting only 14 million," said another analyst.
"The prospect of flatter growth overall is the other main factor afflicting the shares," he said.
By 0740 GMT the stock was 39-1/2p weaker at 217p.
